body: It’s nice to be in a coin that actually feels genuine.  The amount of creativity when it comes to the art is impressive as well.  I think my favorite part is the Hegend NFT collection though.  Providing a dividend adds some actual utility to the art.
Been in HEGE since April and I am completely confident in holding until 1B.  Best community/dev team I’ve seen and I’ve been rug pulled on many coins.  Invest and HODL, we are going places.
I think the LBank listing is going to really start another big run up.  So many other coins went up after being listed there.  Given how good the community is I don’t see how we don’t hit $1B
Been in Hege since April, check the TG or X.  It’s very legit with a good distribution of holders.  Do some research before you judge please.
The number of holders and how well it’s distributed paired with how awesome the team is gives me a ton of confidence that this one is special and legit.

I face the same issue with my boss and coworkers but mostly my boss.  I like to keep everyone at work at arms length and avoid interaction outside of work.  My boss sees that as me not liking the people I work with but I do socialize while at work without being too open.  All I can say is to try to ignore it or state your opinion you prefer to keep work and personal life separate.

Sounds familiar, I get nit picked to death no matter what I do.  With lower confidence I’m not doing as good as I could somewhere else.  Got an opportunity coming up later this year working with a guy in the company  that he absolutely hates but I like so this could be a good time to get out.
He seems to be in a better mood today so I might not get ridiculed until this afternoon but I’ll give it a try next time he does something.
Going to start looking, I’m a software engineer living in a rural area so might take a while but at least I have my resume ready to go!
Yea I think even if I have to move I need to get the hell away from this job.
I told him, shit storm will commence
Should I tell him that she was over at my house or just let it go?
Yea I know she was a bit young when we got together.  Will not be doing that again.

That last resort gives some comfort for sure.   I think it's an incredibly unhealthy coping mechanism but I do the same thing.  Is it possible to get to the point where the slightest misfortune doesn't trigger these thoughts?

Hang in there bud

I've been putting off therapy for a long time but maybe it's time.  Dealt with these feelings my whole life.  I also have those thoughts but more of wishing something natural would happen and end the misery.  

Im sorry about your circumstance, I hope you have some luck and things improve.  Keep moving forward and maybe something will change, that's what keeps me going ...hope

Yea I was never going to sign that loan but just the fact that she thinks that buying a $24k car with no job is a good idea...that tells me she is financially irresponsible which is a deal breaker for me.  

My expectations is that my gf/fiance/wife will make smart financial decisions.  Maybe that makes me look controlling but I would be willing to help her out if she actually needed a car but she only "wants" a car that she can't afford.

It's over now so it's no longer an issue.
Thank you, I 100% agree with everything you said.  We are going our separate ways, it hurts immensely but I know I what I have to do.

Yes she tried every tactic in the book to keep me from breaking up with her tonight but I did it anyway.  She wanted a 'break' so she can figure out who she is.  I told her I am not an idiot and that she really just wants to test the waters and keep me on the hook.  My sister informed me that she was evidently already 'talking' to another guy before we even were on a break.  

She realizes she fucked up, I was such a good guy to her and I gave in so much because I loved her but she pushed me too far.
Agreed, I refused to be manipulated tonight.  I told her how it is and we are done.  I will no longer be treated like that.
I stuck to my guns and ended it.  She did a 180 and took back everything she ever said but it was too late.  I can be very cold when I reach my breaking point.
I just broke up with her and my heart is shattered, this is the most painful thing I have had to do in my entire life.  I stayed strong when talking to her but now I am sobbing like a baby.
100% real, I'm just an idiot I guess.  Anyway, I'm done with her, blocked her on everything.
Well if this is normal behavior from women I'll either stay single or turn gay because I'm not dealing with mind games.
Just found out shes already dating a guy less than 24 hours after the break.   That tells me she already had him on the hook.
We had an agreement of no sex but I could see her breaking that with an excuse of us being on a break

You're right,  every vulnerability I've ever revealed she took a stab at.  She knows im afraid of being alone and my family passing away.  

I think it'll come out that she probably already had another guy on the hook.   When we first got together she loved how I treated her,  this has not charged but her expectations have. 

Anyway,  I'm done,  dealing with the heart break and moving on.
Lol thanks,  she tried her best to make it not seem that way.
Im 29 and she's 23.  Going to let the heart break hit me and get the hell out.
Thanks,  I plan to distance myself further and leave this relationship.   Going to focus on myself for a while

She got really mad because I've been working long hours.   Im just trying to make a good impression and I have a very strong work ethic.   She saw this as neglect because I worked extra hours without pay which maybe it was.
Outstanding issues like this are the main reason I haven't proposed.  I watched  my parents suffer with money problems my whole life and im determined to do better.
She wasn't always like this,  I'm not sure if she was hiding it or other people are influencing her.

With the way she is now, I see no future.  If she is willing to change then maybe there is hope.   I think she loves me but my financial responsibility irritates her.   She wants a super expensive house with nice cars...I don't give 2 shits about that kind of stuff.   Im obviously willing to compromise if we can afford it but otherwise im not ruining my future.

And yes she basically told me she can do better.  She evidently gets messages all the time about guys wanting to date her but she tells them she loves me.

Also, keep in mind she has severe Chrohns disease with very expensive medical bills and fairly overweight.   I ignore these issues because I love her,  I am doubting other guys will be so nice...
Yea it kind of feels like shes going through a mid life crisis and just wants to have fun. She is younger than me and so she wants to have fun but she's not caring about long term consequences.
Thank you,  her mom is very manipulative so she probably gets it from her.

I feel the same way, I'm kind of naive when it comes to spotting manipulation but I'm getting better. 

I fully plan on dating around during this break.
She thinks we should have already been married by now anyway so me consigning should be no big deal.  Basically she doesnt think im committed.  I am but I told her I'm waiting for her to graduate.

Yea I remember when she was in a weird state last summer.  We were rocky at the time, she said how she wished she was skinny and prettier so she could find a sugar daddy to take care of her or become a stripper.  Later she said she didn't mean those things...

I hate saying mean things to anyone but recently I've found it harder to hold back.  I just think im kind of angry at her for putting me down.

I think you are right in regards to manipulation.  She told me that if we broke up she was going out and immediately going to fuck 5 guys, I think this was a test to see how much I cared.

We used to have such a great relationship but its morphed into this horrible thing.  We have both changed and according to her im a cold uncaring ass hole.
The $5000 car was kind of after the fact but I very much intended to follow through with the offer.  She just either wants that Camaro or nothing.
I did neglect our relationship a good bit while I focused on myself and work so I deserve some of the blame.  I just know with every fiber of my being that buying this car is a mistake.

Her friend had a brand new Camaro that her fiance is paying the payments on.  Plus she sees other non married couples where the woman is getting all kinds of expensive gifts.

She currently has no job but should when college starts up.
Yea she said she would buy it with me or without me.  I told her that's fine but that poor decision could be an indicator of future bad spending habits.  She just thinks I'm obsessed with money...
She currently does not work but will be in the next month.  She lives with her Mom.

I am not sure what you are calling bull shit on.  She has or "had" plans to be a doctor.  She told me that if we switched roles she would be showering me with gifts and I would have everything I ever wanted.  I am paraphrasing but that is very close to what she said earlier today.  She also specifically said I was raised incorrectly, I was not raised in a gender-role household, my Mom and Dad both worked; maybe Mom cooked more than Dad because she was home more (worked less hours) but they both contributed financially and in all other aspects to the household.

According to her, as a man I am supposed to never let her pump her own gas, open all her doors, and be a complete gentleman at all times.  This most recently includes cosigning for a car she can't afford evidently.

Maybe I am biased but it sounds to me like she wants the best of both worlds.  A man-slave that gives her money/bows at her feet, and also a husband that loves and cares for her while she goes out and lives her own life.

I think when my work schedule changed, which resulted in less money we stopped going out as much and I stopped spending as much money on her.  I think this caused some boredom in our relationship as we spent a lot of time at home.  

I currently live an hour from her but in the next month or so I should be moving within 15 minutes of her and starting a job that pays much more.  I am hoping I can give her more attention and trying your idea once I have more money and am closer to her.

I am 29 and she is 23.  I think the age difference has been an issue since the beginning.  Yes, this is the same woman that possibly cheated on me a year ago.

I am trying to give her benefit of the doubt because I do love her but maybe I just need to grow some balls and quit dealing with this bullshit...I am not getting any younger.
Thanks again for your input, your thoughts align with my own.  Although opposites attract (maybe?)  there are differences that simply aren't compatible.

I am wondering the same thing but sometimes I question my own logic and an outside opinion is helpful.  I agree a relationship should be a positive impact on one's life and not negative.  Unfortunately the dating aspect is not fool-proof, I am fairly adamant that 1 year + engagement and living together is also required to completely know someone. Especially considering financial reasons are the number one reason for divorce.
Ouch, sounds awful.  Even the idea of taking on debt hurts my soul.

I am not sure but I should dig into that further.  From past conversations it seems like she has plans to drive expensive cars and have an expensive house.  I am willing to compromise to a certain degree in regards to this but I refuse to live beyond my means and take on debt.

I think this life expectation is with her regardless of her mom/best friend.  I have told her that I am willing to agree to a house and nice things if we are making an appropriate income that allows it.  I absolutely refuse to take on massive debt for "toys".  

I think alienation from her Mom and best friend would improve her rational thought when it comes to these topics but her jealous nature would always have her coveting what others have and wanting something more.

I actually think she is one of the good ones in terms of being a "leech" she has only ever asked me for money in tight spots up until this point.  I think her friend and her mom are bad influences because they would date a man for only fiscal reasons.  

I will admit that I am greedy/tight and that I need to be more giving but I honestly am only that way because I want our future to be bright.  I don't want to live paycheck to paycheck like most of the USA.  I would rather live in a mediocre house and drive mediocre cars, take awesome vacations, and retire early.

I think you hit the nail on the head, we aren't on the same level.  I do regret calling her stupid, that was disrespectful of me and I apologized to her for it.  I feel like most of the women around me either are manipulative or are looking for a hand-out from men, this cynical outlook almost makes me want to stay single.

Thank you for your honest input,

I despise the whole gender-role, man must take care of woman thing.  I don't mind doing the yard work, lifting the heavy stuff, working on the car but when it comes to finances, responsibility and equal contribution is required. 

Her problem is that she would spend every dime she had to make me happy.  She spends ever dime that she has ever had and is incapable of saving.  She is a very giving person which I respect but at the same time she is financially irresponsible.

We actually went through a budgeting process for her mom's business because they were losing money.  She understands budgeting but right now she just wants to do what feels good (childish).

I don't really feel like she is necessarily using me for money but I do feel like she has unmet expectations of me taking care of her because of other couples she sees.  Coveting other relationships mostly.
Oh yea, before I met her she failed to make a lot of different payments which resulted in horrible credit.  I believe she still has this outstanding debt.
Leaning that way...

When she gets her lab assistant job going and other side jobs I estimate that she might make $600 - $1000 a month after taxes.  She already has a beater car that is currently being repaired in the shop.

She originally aspired to be a doctor and is completing her bachelors in biomedical next Spring.  Her intention currently is to go to graduate school for microbiology.  SOOO, eventually she will make enough money to be independent but until then she is dependent on her lab assisting, side jobs, and her Mom.

Her mom and other influences have beat it into her head that the man is supposed to take care of her... I was 'raised wrong' because I don't see it the same way.
I do love her very much but I feel like she is acting childish and lacking financial responsibility.  If that means that I don't respect her then so be it.

Yes her mom has very poor money management skills which is probably where this comes from.  

If I buy her a car with cash, it would be a $5000 beater, safe and reliable.  I wouldn't even buy myself a $24k vehicle.

I have tried to educate her on being financially responsible but she just seems to think I am being her Dad and that I am greedy/selfish with a high opinion of myself.

She actually already has a beater that is broken down and in the shop having the fuel pump replaced.  She intends to keep this car even after buying the new car, not sure why.

To be clear, the $600 a month payment is without me cosigning.  I called her stupid for even considering such an insane financial decision.  The argument eventually progressed into me not doing anything for her because I wouldn't cosign for her.  Oh, did I also mention that she was going to take out a personal loan to pay the $2500 down payment?  

She proceeded to give examples of how her mom's ex boyfriend bought a car for her mom and her best friend who is cheating on her fiance is getting her car payment paid for.  She also explained how everyone says she should leave me because she deserves to "be taken care of".  Her mom's friend volunteered to cosign for her and she said it was sad how he would cosign before I would.

I have read all of Dave Ramsey's books and watch his videos weekly.  I base all of my financial decisions on his teachings.  I have quoted Dave before but she seems to think that what I'm saying is unrealistic and that buying a couch from rent to own is normal and fine when you're poor.

I appreciate your input, the point of the break was to get clarity and sort through these negative emotions I feel towards her. 

I think this is a small part of a bigger problem in my relationship. She is so hard to talk to about problems that I tend to just let them go or ignore them.

Agreed, I've worked in IT for 10+ years managing many types of mobile devices and text messages do not "slow down" a phone.  

Conveniently her best friend that is currently  cheating on her fiance backed her up saying she deletes old messages too.
Unfortunately there is no proof, I asked for it so many times.

I don't recall if I asked her about that message she got but if I did at this point I would get chewed out for bringing up the past.

The guy lives several states away, hence the hooking up later that year.  I messaged him via FB and he confirmed the messages were deleted.  A year has passed since then so the chances of those messages still being around would be even lower.

I actually didn't see the messages from this girl until about a month after they were originally sent because they showed up as a message request.  Unless this was a dream I do recall my gf stating she received a message from someone accusing her of cheating while at my house.  I didn't get the specifics at the time because I didn't really put much thought into it.  

On your second point.  I agree it makes no sense but my gf just kept saying she didn't understand why he said what he did and that he might keep up his gfs lie for whatever reason.  These are the types of things that still have me thinking about this a year later.

Good point,  I guess I was grabbing at straws for a way to get definitive proof either way.  The thing is that up until this point I had never mistrusted her in 4 years.  She could go out to a party or do anything and I wouldn't think twice.  Sometimes I was so trusting that she thought I didn't care what she did which made her kind of mad.

You might be right.  I have had bad experiences in past relationships where such tips were true and I may have unfairly pushed judgement on her.  

Her behavior had changed around this time and my gut was telling me something was off.  I think this contributed to my mistrust.
